note: After the genus-level monograph description of Roonwal & Chhotani (1989) (in English), itself adapted from the original description of Maiti 1975; the soldier and pseudoworker are described and measured, the alate being given in the original as Imago Unknown. The pseudoworker body length is OCR-read as 6.00-1 LOO mm and is corrected by magnitude to 6.00—11.00 mm. The type specimens were examined; type locality Bong Basti, Kalimpong (Darjeeling District), West Bengal, India, 1209 m elevation, known only from the type locality.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brownish; antennae, postclypeus and labrum slightly darker; mandibles black, near black-brown at the base; legs and body yellow-white. Head and body sparsely hairy. Body length 13.50—15.50 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, sides parallel (length to mandible base 3.80—4.20, maximum width 2.70—2.80 mm); width about two-thirds of the length (width/length index 0.64—0.72); posterior margin rounded; frons inclined forwards and slightly concave in the middle; Y suture distinct. Compound eyes oval (long diameter 0.32—0.37, short diameter 0.21—0.25 mm), about one short diameter from the antennae. Ocelli absent. Postclypeus and frons indistinctly delimited, each side of the anterior part with a pair of short hairs. Anteclypeus hairless, transparent, band-like. Labrum wider than long, anterior margin rounded (length 0.48—0.55, width 0.72—0.81 mm). Antennae 15—16-segmented; segment 3 strongly sclerotized, shorter than segment 2 in the 16-segmented antenna, conical and longer than segment 2 and about twice segment 4 in the 15-segmented antenna. Mandibles short and stout, with a distinct swelling on the outer margin near the base, slightly more than half the head length (length 2.24—2.30 mm, mandible length/head length index 0.53—0.58). Left mandible with 5 marginal teeth, the first and second rather conspicuous, the third and fourth weak, the margin between the second and third long, the fifth larger than the third or fourth; right mandible with 2 conspicuous marginal teeth in the middle. Postmentum long, club-shaped; widest at the anterior lobe of the club; narrowing posteriorly into a long and narrow waist; waist slightly more than one-third of the maximum width (length 2.80—3.00, maximum width 0.90—0.92, waist width 0.33—0.37 mm). Pronotum flat, subrectangular, slightly wider than the head (length 1.16—1.20, maximum width 2.85—2.90 mm; pronotum width/head width index 1.02—1.04); anterior margin rather deeply incurved with a median notch; sides rounded; posterior margin convex. Legs short and stout, tibial spur formula 3:3:3, the middle tibia sometimes with an additional spur; tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen slender; cerci and styli present.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pseudoworker: head milky white; antennae, legs and body concolorous with the head; labrum and postclypeus slightly darker. Body length 6.00—11.00 mm. Head capsule subcircular, slightly wider than long (head length to mandible base 1.70—2.10, head width 2.00—2.20 mm). Compound eyes reduced, unpigmented. Postclypeus flat, short, with a few hairs anteriorly; anteclypeus transparent, hairless. Labrum dome-shaped, wider than long (length 0.48—0.55, width 0.70—0.80 mm). Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum wider than the head, flat, anterior margin rather deeply incurved with a median notch; posterior margin convex, medially concave (length 1.17—1.30, width 2.30—2.50 mm). Legs and abdomen as in the soldier.
